Plugin.Name: QNAP Hardware
Plugin.ExtraSearchTerms: qnap tl-d1600s qxp jbod enclosure bay temperature history
Plugin.Overview:
A live overview of the QNAP TL-D1600S JBOD enclosure under Unraid.
- A front view with each drive in its bay, its slot, temperature and state; no drive is woken. - Bay labels on the Main page. - Drive temperature history per bay. - A hardware inventory with known issues and firmware. - A Report tab that anonymises what your unit looks like, for support of other models.
For the card checks, Locate and the cabling check, install the companion plugin, QNAP Expansion.
